obfuscation_indicators: unpredictable and may not be recurring
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and transparent, but emphasizes management’s positive execution narrative while acknowledging lower volumes, margin pressure, oversupply, inventory write-downs, currency effects, and working-capital demands. Results rely partly on nonrecurring gains, including litigation-related tax credits and exchange gains, which may reduce earnings quality. Forward-looking outcomes remain exposed to oversupply, crop variability, delayed shipments, customer demand, and foreign-exchange risk.
